scope: One bounded provider/contract metadata compatibility probe, followed only on separate authorization by a frozen economic falsifier. No transaction submission, credentials, wallet, market quotes, raw shared inputs, pool substitution or new venue scan.

mechanism.name: Native ETH primary issuance followed by atomic secondary sale
cycle: actual minted stETH sold to native ETH on one fixed Curve pool
zero-credit disposal of all residual stETH shares
native ETH with zero residual shares
mechanism.edge_source: An executable secondary-market premium over primary issuance value, large enough to cover one AMM leg, all transaction costs and reserved capital. This is a necessary-condition hypothesis, not observed alpha.
mechanism.distinction: One deterministic issuance leg replaces the second AMM leg in the repository's previously tested two-pool cycles. No future basis convergence, redemption queue, yield accrual, forecast, order-book signal or passive limit fill is credited.
mechanism.novelty_limit: Distinct within the checked repository studies and from root's passive-PERP lane; this familiar arbitrage family is not claimed to be a new market discovery.
mechanism.evidence_status: Primary documentation and source review only. No executable premium, market liquidity, profitability, submission latency, inclusion probability or realized result has been observed.
mechanism.prior_expectation: Permissionless arbitrage competition and a potentially absent stETH premium make a negative necessary-condition result plausible. One cheap falsifier is justified; extended infrastructure or economic collection is not yet justified.

fixed_contracts.binding_status: Addresses come from official documentation. Exact live code hashes, implementation address and ABI compatibility are unverified. A documentation/live mismatch stops this version; it does not select a replacement.

atomic_transition_requirements: Start the hypothetical executor with zero stETH shares and no unrelated inventory; use one fixed prefunded native-ETH principal arm, plus a separately reserved gas budget.
Check issuance eligibility within the composed transaction. Call submit with the exact native principal. Its return value is shares, not nominal token quantity.

Read actual minted shares and actual credited stETH balance after submit. Approve only the fixed Curve pool for the observed nominal balance and execute exchange(1,0,dx,min_dy). Do not chain independent view quotes across the state-changing issuance leg.

Measure actual native ETH received. Transfer every remaining stETH share to the fixed dust sink with transferShares, assign zero cash recovery, and require sharesOf(executor)==0. Displayed balanceOf==0 alone is insufficient.

Return all native proceeds to the hypothetical payer, include any approval cleanup and disposal operations, and account for aggregate payer/executor native balance change. No outside token redemption or terminal marked inventory is permitted.

Execute and simulate the complete operation as one state transition. Included reverts undo token state but charge gas. RPC rejection, simulated revert, modeled non-inclusion and actual included revert must retain distinct statuses.

Primary contract/source compatibility, transaction gas including intrinsic/setup/refund effects, and exact flatness are prerequisites for an economic result. Metadata getters alone cannot establish these.

metadata_probe.purpose: First falsify access to atomic success/revert gas evidence, then bind fixed contract identities and issuance eligibility without observing the market premium.
metadata_probe.endpoint_basis: PublicNode's official Ethereum mainnet endpoint page; no claim that it supports eth_simulateV1 until probed.
metadata_probe.request_policy: Sequential calls only. No retries, alternate endpoints, methods, block, contract or pool after a failure. Stop at the first transport, ABI, identity, capability, canonicality or resource failure. Preserve a bounded terminal record and all admitted request outcomes.
metadata_probe.block_policy: The first successful latest header fixes block number, hash, parent hash, timestamp and state root. Contract calls/code reads use EIP-1898 blockHash with requireCanonical=true. eth_simulateV1 uses that numeric parent block because its documented selector is number/tag; a final same-number header must match the original hash. A recheck cannot exclude a reorg out and back between calls. Record this number-parent limitation even on success; do not claim all observations were proven to share one canonical state. Any detected mismatch invalidates the probe.

synthetic_probe.required_evidence: One simulated child block, exactly two call records with empty calldata, zero value and no access list: first status 1, exactly 32-byte return value 42 and gasUsed exactly 21018; second status 0, empty returnData, explicit revert evidence and gasUsed exactly 21006. These include intrinsic gas, unlike execution-only 18/6. Reject inconsistent results rather than silently changing the gas expectation. This establishes only the provider's synthetic gas/status interface; it is not a market trade or proof of Lido/Curve execution.
synthetic_probe.override_scope: Only the three named scratch accounts and synthetic child-block fee context. No Lido, Curve or other live contract code/storage/balance overrides. All overrides are ephemeral RPC simulation inputs.

request_manifest.expect: valid canonical header; retain only header projection plus raw response hash
canonical ABI bool; paused is an eligibility failure, not negative profit
uint256; report each proposed native arm eligibility without resizing
uint256 in documented fee denominator 10^10; record, no quote
uint256 in denominator 10^10; not an extra trader fee on top of pool output

metadata_probe.maximum_positive_conclusion: Synthetic success/revert gas interface and specified metadata are accessible, with contract metadata hash-bound and the simulation parent only number-bound plus a header recheck. Exact compiled-source/live-bytecode equivalence, full atomic route correctness and every economic claim remain unproven.

later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.sizing: All four arms are independent fixed-capital policies and must be reported. No dollar conversion or dollar ceiling is inferred; 100-unit prior screens are a baseline, not a ceiling. No outcome-driven resizing or best-arm-only report.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.timing: Freeze calendar anchors, local receipt/decision clocks, earliest eligible inclusion slot and a single transaction-position convention before any quote. A block timestamp alone does not prove observation latency or obtainable inclusion. Use a seconds-to-minutes timeout and keep missed attempts in the denominator.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.state: One full EVM transition at the predeclared hypothetical inclusion position must include issuance, approvals, market sale, exact share disposal, native payout, setup and gas. Ethereum block/state and any intervening state must be explicit. Neither separately quoted legs nor a static post-block quote demonstrate this.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.economics: Native net cash equals final aggregate payer/executor ETH less initial ETH less any separately modeled builder payment and capital charge. If gas is already debited in the simulated payer balance, never subtract it twice. Pool fee is included in actual sale output. Any setup/deployment/approval/disposal must be charged; do not give a free predeployed executor without an explicit amortization policy.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.capital_charge: 5% annual charge on the whole reserved principal plus gas reserve for the fixed policy's elapsed reserved time, including idle intervals and failed or missed attempts. Size arms do not share the same capital for free.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.failure_accounting: Report transport/missing state, model rejection, decision abstention, predicted non-inclusion, simulated success/revert and any later real inclusion evidence separately. An included failed transaction pays its observed/modeled gas. An unavailable result is not a zero-cash observation.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.cheap_rejection: If every complete composed observation returns at most its principal even before gas in the fixed sample, the premium necessary condition fails in those observed states. Missing states and unsupported calls are coverage failures, not negative economic samples. A transient positive static premium that disappears after delay/full composition also fails this mechanism for that sample.
later_economic_falsifier_requirements_no.positive_limit: Positive simulated all-cost cash under an assumed position is only conditional opportunity evidence. It cannot establish an obtainable inclusion edge, fill rate, competitor priority or realized profitability. A further bounded inclusion/competition design would be required.

budget_request.source_of_reclassification: Existing 6291456-byte derived allocation, not extra total storage. Two raw copies at most 262144 bytes each, including any retained inline transport envelope if returned to peer.
budget_request.execution_boundary: No RPC until coordinator grants the reclassification and the exact source/protocol/runtime/endpoint/request payloads are frozen. A positive metadata result authorizes no economic capture by itself.

review.parent: Source/design synthesis and repository nonduplication check.
review.independent_agents: Two existing Sol xhigh agents reviewed mechanism/rounding/inclusion. Additional independent source-only review supports the bounded provider capability gate, with exact intrinsic-inclusive gas checks and explicit numeric-parent reorg limitations incorporated.

primary_sources.use: Immediate submit issuance, returned shares, pause/limit gates, version and share methods.
Fixed Ethereum Lido proxy/implementation and legacy Curve pool identity; live verification remains necessary.
Reviewed _submit has no separate principal fee and changes share/buffer state; exact internal conversion must be used. Tag is a source reference, not a verified live bytecode match.
Share/token rounding and precise transferShares disposal; documented dust examples are not a permanent upper bound.
ERC897 implementation()/proxyType() source semantics; requires live proxy identity verification.
Legacy coin order, fee-inclusive exchange and stETH balance handling. Mutable upstream reference is not a frozen source binding or live-code proof.
Queued redemption cannot close this atomic cycle.
eth_simulateV1 ephemeral overrides, validation mode and per-call success/revert gas/status; eth_call alone has no transaction gas receipt.
Public Ethereum mainnet RPC endpoint identity only; capability and reliability untested.
Hash-bound canonical reads and limits of number-based calls with header rechecks.
Native gas cost, failed transaction cost and fee/inclusion distinction.
Simulation is not an inclusion guarantee.
Primary research basis for treating public atomic arbitrage competition and ordering as material limits, not assumed profit.
